idea-plugin.name: View-in-Browser Leak Audit
idea-plugin.description:
24 rules read the .html file you are about to open in the browser and flag every line that behaves differently once the page has a public URL: live API keys, localhost and file:// paths, http:// resources, a leftover noindex.

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → View-in-Browser Leak Audit: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 24 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/view-in-browser-leak-audit (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/view-in-browser-leak-audit

action.text: View-in-Browser Leak Audit: Check This File
action.description: Run View-in-Browser Leak Audit on the file in the editor
